validation.username: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dot or underscore, with no leading, trailing or repeated dot.
validation.passwordMin: The password must have at least 12 characters.
validation.passwordMax: The password can have at most 128 characters.
validation.totp: Enter the 6 digits from the app.

auth.displayNameHint: How your friends will see you. You can change it anytime.
auth.usernameHint: Your unique handle, used by friends to find you.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works well.
auth.loginDescription: Use your @username and password or a passkey.
auth.passkeyFailed: Could not sign in with the passkey.
auth.totpDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.registerDescription: Choose how your friends will find you.
auth.firstAdminDescription: This is the first account on this instance: it will be the administrator.
auth.inviteRequiredDescription: This instance only accepts accounts by invite. Ask someone who already uses Papinho for a link.
auth.inviteInvalidDescription: The invite expired, was revoked or reached its usage limit.
auth.registrationClosedDescription: This instance is not accepting new accounts.
auth.recoveryCodesDescription: Each code works once and is the only way to recover your account if you forget your password. They will not be shown again.
auth.recoverDescription: Use one of the recovery codes you saved when creating your account.
auth.recovered: Password reset. Sign in with the new password.

shell.welcomeDescription: Pick a chat or open a contact to start.

contacts.emptyDescription: Add someone by @username, link or QR Code.
contacts.addDescription: Type the @username of the person you want to add.
contacts.myLinkDescription: Anyone who opens this link or scans the QR Code can add you.
contacts.blockConfirmDescription: Blocked people cannot send you messages, see your photo, about or presence, nor add you to groups.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.description: Create an invite link. Whoever opens it can create an account on this instance.

profile.aboutHint: A short phrase your contacts can see.
profile.cropDescription: Drag to position and use the slider to zoom. Location data in the photo is removed.

account.usernameCooldown: You can change it again on {{date}}.
account.usernameReservation: Your old @username stays reserved for you for 30 days.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Download a ZIP with everything that is yours on Papinho: account, profile, contacts, settings, the messages you sent and the list of your files (data portability).

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Deletes the account, profile, contacts and settings. Messages you sent stay with whoever received them, as "Deleted account". This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: Type your password to confirm. You leave all groups and every session is ended.

security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
security.totpScan: Scan the QR Code in your authenticator app (or type the key) and confirm with the generated code.
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in without a password using your device's biometrics or screen lock.
security.passkeysUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.

sessions.description: Devices with an open session on your account.

admin.title: Administration
admin.breachedCheck: Reject breached passwords (queries Have I Been Pwned)
admin.temporaryPasswordDescription: Send it through a secure channel. It is shown only now; ask the person to change it after signing in.
admin.roleChanged: Role changed; it applies when the person signs in again

chat.emptyListDescription: Open a contact to start chatting.
chat.requestsEmptyDescription: Messages from people who are not in your contacts show up here.
chat.requestBanner: {{name}} is not in your contacts. Until you accept, they can't see whether you are online or have read.
chat.starredEmptyDescription: Use Star in a message menu to keep it here.
chat.blockedNotice: You blocked this person. Unblock to chat.
chat.cannotSend: You can't send messages in this chat.
chat.blockConfirmDescription: They won't be able to message you or see your photo, about or online status. They are not notified.
chat.deleteDescription: "Delete for everyone" removes the content and files from the server for everybody; a deleted-message notice remains.
chat.deleteForMeDescription: The message disappears only for you, on all your devices.

timer.title: Disappearing messages
timer.hint: Applies to messages sent from now on, for everyone in the chat.
timer.defaultDescription: Chats and groups you start begin with this timer.

chat.savedEmpty: Keep notes, links and files here, just for you.
chat.scheduledDescription: They go out on their own at the set time, even with the app closed.
chat.scheduleFailed: Could not be sent at the set time

moderation.reportDescription: The last 5 messages of this conversation will be sent to the instance administrator. They are not notified.

media.sendDescription: Photos, videos and documents up to 1 GB. The upload resumes where it stopped if the connection drops.
media.caption: Caption (optional)
media.tooLarge: Files over 1 GB cannot be sent.
media.retryLost: The file is no longer available. Choose it again.

audio.microphoneDenied: Could not use the microphone. Check the browser permission.

transcription.label: Transcript
transcription.providerHelp: In the browser, the audio never leaves your device; on the server, Papinho sends the audio to the provider configured by the administrator.
transcription.modelSmall: Whisper small quantized (≈250 MB, more accurate)
transcription.browserHelp: Downloaded once per device, on the first transcription. Uses WebGPU when available.
transcription.name: Name
transcription.apiKeyHelp: Encrypted on the server and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.

groups.newGroupDescription: Name it and pick contacts; you can add more people later.
groups.name: Group name
groups.inviteHint: Anyone with the link can join. Reset it to invalidate the current one.
groups.joinApproval: Approve new members joining via link
groups.leaveDescription: Only admins notice you left; the group is not notified.
groups.onlyAdminsNotice: Only admins can send messages to this group.
groups.pendingApproval: Request sent. An admin needs to approve you.
groups.alreadyMember: You are already in this group.
groups.invalidInvite: This invite link does not exist or was disabled.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.paletteDescription: Search for a chat or an action.
shortcuts.pasteImage: Paste an image or file in the field
shortcuts.dragHint: You can also drag and drop files into the chat.
shortcuts.privateMode: Turn private mode (blur) on or off

poll.newDescription: Ask something and let people vote; results show in real time.
poll.question: Question

viewOnce.title: View once
viewOnce.screenshotWarning: Opens only once, with no download or forwarding. Note: the browser cannot prevent screenshots.
viewOnce.hidden: Hidden while the app is in the background

broadcast.description: Each person gets it as a one-on-one chat with you. Only people who have you as a contact receive it.
broadcast.name: List name
broadcast.onlyContacts: Only people who have you as a contact receive messages.
broadcast.expired: This list has expired and no longer sends messages.

sticker.label: Sticker
sticker.manageDescription: Packs are shared with everyone on this instance. Upload WebP files (static or animated) up to 1 MB.

gif.label: GIF
gif.unavailable: Could not search GIFs right now.

privacy.whoCanSeeDescription: Applies to people who have a chat with you. By default everything is visible, as on WhatsApp.

item.GROUPS_ADD: Who can add me to groups

privacy.reciprocity: If you don't share yours, you can't see other people's.

exceptions.description: Checked contacts won't see this item.

privacy.groupsDescription: People who can't add you are told to send you the group invite link.
privacy.readReceiptsDescription: Applies to one-to-one chats. If you turn it off, you won't see when others read either. In groups it stays on, but you can turn it off per group.

blur.title: Private mode
blur.description: Blurs what you choose for people looking at your screen from afar. It's only visual: hover, use the keyboard or touch and hold to see.
blur.revealHint: Keyboard focus and long press reveal right away.

screenLock.title: Screen lock
screenLock.description: Covers Papinho with its own PIN or password, separate from your account password. It's visual protection: the session stays active.
screenLock.idle: Lock after a period of inactivity
screenLock.onHidden: Lock when switching tabs or windows
screenLock.shortcutHint: Click and press a letter or digit with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Meta. Esc cancels.
screenLock.currentToTurnOff: Current code to turn it off
screenLock.visualOnly: Visual protection: the session stays active on this device.

conversation.reciprocity: When off, you also won't see when others read in this chat.

locked.folderTitle: Enter the code for your locked chats
locked.empty: No chat opened with this code
locked.emptyDescription: Lock a chat from its details panel.
locked.lockDescription: The chat leaves the list and goes to the Locked chats folder; its content only opens with the code. Use the same code as another chat to open both together.
locked.codeHint: 4 to 64 characters. A forgotten code can't be recovered.
locked.unlockedForGood: The chat is back in the list

organize.muteDescription: You still receive the messages, without notifications.
organize.muteMentions: Still notify me when I am mentioned
organize.clearDescription: The messages disappear only for you, on all your devices.
organize.removeDescription: The chat and its messages disappear only for you. It comes back when a new message arrives.
organize.removeGroupDescription: The messages disappear only for you and the chat leaves the list until a new message arrives. To leave the group, use the group info.
organize.foldersDescription: Group chats to filter the list. Only you see your lists.
organize.deleteFolderDescription: The chats stay in the main list.
organize.keepArchived: Keep chats archived when a new message arrives
organize.keepArchivedDescription: Without this option, a new message takes the chat out of the archive.
organize.exportDescription: Downloads a ZIP with the messages as text, in WhatsApp format. Messages you deleted for yourself and view-once ones are left out.
organize.exportMedia: Include photos, videos, audio and documents

pwa.updateDescription: Update whenever you like; the page will reload.

notifications.browserDescription: The browser asks for permission once. With the app closed, alerts arrive by push.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the site settings of your browser.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not show notifications.
notifications.pushUnavailable: This browser does not receive push with the app closed; alerts show only while Papinho is open.
notifications.internetDescription: With the app closed, the alert goes through the browser's push service (Google, Mozilla or Apple). On a local network without internet, alerts arrive only while Papinho is open. The text is encrypted; turn on "Hide content" in Privacy to send only "New message".
notifications.iosTitle: On iPhone and iPad, install the app
notifications.iosDescription: iOS only delivers push to Papinho added to the Home Screen: in Safari, tap Share and "Add to Home Screen", then turn on notifications there.

toggleHint.mentions: When someone writes your @username or @todos, even with groups off.

notifications.perConversation: For a single chat, use Mute in its menu.

connection.offline: No connection. You see recent chats and your texts go out when the connection is back.
